scope: Overflow repair with unchanged finite WMMA output; not a new topline or task-quality benchmark
baseline: Saved pre-repair T16 Q8 WMMA library, with dense down WMMA enabled in both arms
candidate: Same resident model and routes, inline FP32 recomputation only for non-finite WMMA accumulator elements
command: env -u HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python scripts/gemma4_dense_range_ab.py --baseline-library /tmp/gemma4-q8-wmma-before.so --json /tmp/gemma4-range-ab-final.json
protocol: One residency; four alternating-order pairs per prompt length; eight greedy output tokens; one full-shape warmup per arm and length; separate public LLM.generate_detailed checks
interpretation: Observed median changes span -0.46% to +0.75%; no statistical claim of zero overhead. The blanket down-projection opt-out is absent.

correctness.overflow_matrix: BF16 rows 4/17/33; normal/boundary/overflow/mixed; single/two/four-wave; FP32 CPU oracle and deterministic repeat
correctness.red: Pre-repair boundary input produced NaNs; normal cases passed
correctness.raw_logits_command: env -u HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python scripts/gemma4_dense_range_ab.py --baseline-library /tmp/gemma4-q8-wmma-before.so --pairs 1 --json /tmp/gemma4-range-logits.json
correctness.raw_logits: All eight uncapped full-vocabulary logit rows per prompt length were finite and SHA-256 identical between arms at shared teacher inputs
correctness.limits: No new full-category quality certification; hardware validation is gfx1151 only
